message.content: Giant pandas evolved from early bear ancestors around 5–8 million years ago during the late Miocene. Fossil evidence shows they diverged from other ursids roughly 2–3 million years ago, developing their distinctive black‑and‑white coat and specialized bamboo diet. Over time, they adapted to cooler, forested habitats in China’s mountainous regions, leading to the modern species we see today.
